convert_gemma_weights_to_hf: convert Gemma model weights from checkpoint format to HuggingFace transformers format using argparse CLI
build_gemma_model_2b: build a HuggingFace GemmaForCausalLM model from 2B checkpoint weights and save to output directory
build_gemma_model_7b: build a HuggingFace GemmaForCausalLM model from 7B checkpoint weights and save to output directory
convert_gemma_tokenizer: convert Gemma SentencePiece tokenizer model to HuggingFace GemmaTokenizer format
push_gemma_model_to_hub: push converted Gemma model and tokenizer to HuggingFace Hub instead of saving locally
